2a_live_role_identity.issue: C43 live council smoke evidence contains conflicting role identifiers: raw receipt ROLE_ID=p2p_axiom, adaptive participant set participant_roles=[p2p_datos], owner-facing report described participant as p2p_datos.
conflicting_claims: owner report described live participant as p2p_datos

authoritative_evidence.dispatch_invocation: adapter.execute(...) called with NO role_id parameter; the execution layer carries no role binding
authoritative_evidence.receipt_assembly: receipts[0] ROLE_ID is a hardcoded literal 'p2p_axiom' at assembly time, not read from any backend or role machinery
authoritative_evidence.report_source: owner-facing description derived from participant-set decision, not from the live receipt

2a_live_role_identity.resolution: Neither ROLE_ID is mechanically bound to the executed Manus task. The dispatch was role-agnostic; ROLE_ID='p2p_axiom' is an unsupported handwritten claim in receipt assembly; 'p2p_datos' is the deterministic LOW-risk participant-set classification, not proof of execution role. Canonical claim: C43_LIVE_EXECUTED_ROLE = UNBOUND.
